learning_objective: 🎯 Use area, perimeter, and fractions to become a brilliant farm manager and organize a giant coconut farm!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: To keep the coconuts safe, we need a fence! The perimeter is the total length of the boundary around the farm. We just add up the lengths of all the sides to find it.
Area tells us how much flat space is inside the farm. If we know the area, we can figure out exactly how many coconut trees we have room to plant!
When the coconuts are ready, we use fractions to sort them. Maybe 1/2 of the coconuts are sold for drinking, and 1/4 are used for making sweet coconut oil!

fun_activity.title: 🚧 My Bedroom Boundary
fun_activity.instructions: Use your own footsteps to measure the perimeter of your bedroom! Walk carefully right next to the walls and count how many steps it takes to go all the way around.

quick_recap: ⭐ Perimeter is the outside border or boundary of a shape.
⭐ Area is the amount of space inside a flat shape.
⭐ Fractions help us divide our harvest into different usable parts!
